decisions.what: chose SPSC over MPSC ring buffer
decisions.why: one capture thread per interface; SPSC is simpler and has lower overhead — no CAS retry loops
page-aligned, sparse (OS does not allocate physical pages until written), avoids heap fragmentation at 10M frame scale

decisions.what: CacheLinePadded atomics for head and tail
decisions.why: prevents false sharing between producer (writes head) and consumer (writes tail) which would cause cache-line ping-pong and destroy throughput
CAN FD max payload is 64 bytes; aligning to cache line ensures efficient copies; total size 80 bytes fits in 2 cache lines
extract_timestamp_us needs msghdr but forcing callers to include sys/socket.h just to include cancore.h is poor API hygiene

open_questions: io_uring: use fixed buffers (IORING_OP_RECVMSG) or registered files? Fixed buffers reduce copies but complicate buffer lifecycle.
multi-interface timestamp merge: CLOCK_TAI or CLOCK_MONOTONIC? CLOCK_TAI avoids leap-second discontinuities.
